name: Tourist e-Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Eligible nationalities (many European countries, the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, South Korea, among others) may obtain a visa on arrival or apply in advance via the official eVisa portal (kuwaitvisa.moi.gov.kw), needing a passport valid 6+ months, proof of accommodation, a return ticket, and proof of funds.
requirements.fix_path: Apply via kuwaitvisa.moi.gov.kw or check MOFA's eligibility list before travel.

evidence_required.document: Accommodation proof (hotel booking or host address)

sources.title: Trip Nexus (private visa-guide site) -- Kuwait tourist eVisa/visa-on-arrival requirements, referencing the official portals kuwaitvisa.moi.gov.kw and washington.mofa.gov.kw for the current eligibility list and fees
